mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tianquan_oauth.oauth_subject_revocation_task (id, tenant_id, version, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, deleted_at, identity_sub, target_tenant_id, source_revision, subject_enabled, reason_code, status, next_attempt_at, attempt_count, lease_owner, lease_until) VALUES (#{task.id}, #{task.tenantId}, 0, #{now}, #{actor}, #{now}, #{actor}, NULL, #{task.identitySub}, #{task.targetTenantId}, #{task.sourceRevision}, #{task.subjectEnabled}, #{task.reasonCode}, 'PENDING', #{now}, 0, NULL, NULL)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, version, identity_sub, target_tenant_id, source_revision, subject_enabled, reason_code, status, next_attempt_at, attempt_count, lease_owner, lease_until FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_subject_revocation_task task WHERE task.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.deleted_at IS NULL AND ((task.status = 'PENDING' AND task.next_attempt_at <= #{now}) OR (task.status = 'LEASED' AND task.lease_until <= #{now})) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tianquan_oauth.oauth_subject_revocation_task predecessor WHERE predecessor.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND predecessor.identity_sub = task.identity_sub AND predecessor.target_tenant_id = task.target_tenant_id AND predecessor.source_revision < task.source_revision AND predecessor.status <> 'DONE' AND predecessor.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY task.next_attempt_at, task.id LIMIT #{limit}
